name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-site-monitor
description: Built-in plugin: site identity, feature configuration, and live per-device hashrate via the MDK protocol client.

200.description: Site identity from the gateway configuration.

routes.description: Returns the site name from the gateway config (common.json `site`).

200.description: Feature configuration from the gateway configuration.

routes.description: Returns the `featureConfig` object from the gateway config (common.json `featureConfig`).

200.description: Live per-device hashrate and power with site totals.

400.description: MDK client not connected to a Kernel.

routes.description: Pulls metrics telemetry from every READY worker's devices via the MDK protocol and returns per-device hashrate/power plus site totals.
constraints: Requires the MDK client to be connected to a Kernel instance.
